subsystems.name: Optical sensor module
subsystems.role: measures blood volume changes in finger arteries using light.
parts: optical barriers to reduce stray light

subsystems.name: Motion sensing
subsystems.role: tracks hand movement and orientation for sleep staging and activity recognition.

subsystems.name: Processing and memory
subsystems.role: runs algorithms on the ring for heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV) and sleep stages.

subsystems.name: Power
subsystems.role: provides several days of operation from a very small battery.

subsystems.name: Wireless and charging
subsystems.role: syncs data to a phone and receives charge.

subsystems.name: Mechanical housing
subsystems.role: protects electronics and fits comfortably on a finger.

buildSteps.title: Design the sensor array
buildSteps.detail: Place LEDs and photodiodes to get a strong signal from finger arteries while minimising motion artefacts and crosstalk.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the ring shell
buildSteps.detail: Machine or mould the outer shell and inner structure from biocompatible, skin-safe materials, leaving precise openings for sensors and charging contacts.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the electronics
buildSteps.detail: Populate a flexible or rigid printed circuit board with the sensors, microcontroller, radio and battery, then test each board.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate each unit
buildSteps.detail: Individually calibrate the optical path and motion response so raw readings are comparable across rings.

buildSteps.title: Develop firmware
buildSteps.detail: Write algorithms for PPG signal processing, HRV calculation, sleep staging and aggressive power management to extend battery life.

buildSteps.title: Seal and finish
buildSteps.detail: Insert the electronics into the shell, seal the ring for water resistance, and attach sizing inserts.

buildSteps.title: Validate performance
buildSteps.detail: Test heart-rate accuracy against a chest strap or ECG, sleep staging against lab polysomnography, and battery life under typical use.

prerequisites.why: they measure blood volume changes from a finger, the basis for heart rate and HRV.
they run signal processing on the ring without draining the tiny battery.
it syncs data to a phone with very little energy.
they fit several days of power into a ring-sized cell.

prerequisites.tech: Sleep-staging algorithms from HRV and motion
prerequisites.why: they work reasonably well for many people but are not yet as accurate as lab sleep studies for everyone.

pathway.milestone: consumer rings that track sleep, heart rate and recovery
pathway.unlocks: personal, continuous insight into rest and readiness.

pathway.milestone: improved accuracy and regulatory clearances for detecting irregular heart rhythms
pathway.unlocks: early alerts for conditions such as atrial fibrillation.
continuous monitoring for chronic heart conditions outside hospital.

pathway.unlocks: broader preventive health management from a wearable.
